description: Look up any thing in the slopped.site world by id or name and see how it connects. Covers sites, games, codex entries (characters, creatures, places, objects), Fresh slop artworks, jungle specimens and taxa, secrets (titles only), curriculum pathways and modules, GeoCities homepages, neighbourhoods and rings, history chapters, Bad UI exhibits, Lineage trees, fractal families, clocks and songs. Ids look like "game:spider", "codex:slopwright", "art:detour", "site:jungle", "homepage:lumen". Returns the thing, its link, and every neighbour with the edge type and direction (appears-in, describes, pictures, classifies, owns-homepage, member-of-ring, teaches, unlocks, mentions…). Use for "where does X appear", "what is connected to Y" or "what is the page for Z". Give `to` as well to get the shortest chain of connections between two things.

edge_type.description: Only list neighbours joined by this edge type.

id_or_name.description: A node id ("codex:wren") or a name or old name ("Wren", "Last Card").

to.description: Optional second id or name: also return the shortest path between the two.

type.description: Only match things of this type.

name: world_graph
title: Look something up in the world graph
